title: AEG — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for AEG.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "European Innovation." Specialty tier. AEG is the European brand in the Electrolux portfolio — strong in Europe but limited North American distribution. Known for innovative cooking and laundry technology. May not be available at your retailer.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: European import customers. Limited NA relevance.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for AEG:

• Strong European heritage and technology

• Electrolux Group engineering

• Limited NA distribution — niche import market

• ProCombi Steam ovens in European market

• Growing awareness through Electrolux connection
